name: Idris of Libya
contribution: King of Libya from 24 December 1951 until his ousting in the 1969 Libyan revolution.
legacy: On 24 December 1951, this person announced the establishment of the United Kingdom of Libya from the al-Manar Palace in Benghazi.

checks.lead: Idris (Arabic: إدريس, romanized: Idrīs, Muhammad Idris bin Muhammad al-Mahdi al-Sanusi; 13 March 1890 – 25 May 1983) was King of Libya from 24 December 1951 until his ousting in the 1969 Libyan revolution. He ruled over the United Kingdom of Libya from 1951 to 1963, after which the country became known as simply the Kingdom of Libya. Idris had served as Emir of Cyrenaica and Tripolitania from the 1920s until 1951. He also headed the Sanusi order.
